notes:
Summary:
- SMB B2B SaaS (in-app chat SDK for B2B apps). Primary goal: low-latency streaming chat for end-user flows (mobile first). Self-serve signup; evaluating hosted API first.

Primary contacts:
- Elena Park (Founder / Head of Product) - "We need token-by-token streaming that feels native on iOS"
- Jason Cole (Platform/Infra lead) - concerned about p95 cold-starts and warmup cost

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Workload: interactive in-app chat + contextual history per session (~2-6 turns, avg prompt 250 tokens).
- Latency target: p95 end-to-end generation < 200ms for short replies (<= 60 tokens), typical target 80-150ms on mobile networks.
- Throughput: initial pilot ~10-20 concurrent active sessions, target scale to 200 concurrent sessions in Q3. Spiky bursts during business hours.
- Streaming: must support token-by-token streaming to reduce perceived latency.
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated LLMs; prefers conservative cost profile with fallback to smaller model for cost-sensitive flows.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to low-cost variant when under quota.
- Data: mostly non-sensitive user chat but need audit logs and 30d retention for early compliance. US-only data residency preferred.
- Auth: require SSO/SAML for admin console; API keys for app runtime.

POC / evaluation notes:
- Completed basic integration using self-serve API key. Streaming prototype implemented in iOS using websocket streaming example.
- Observed visible lag on cold-started model for first user session (~500-700ms token latency).
- Customer ran small load test and triggered rate limits (ticket INF-1124). They requested temporary quota bump to proceed with soak test.
- Asked SE for recommended batching/kv-cache settings and quantization tradeoffs (reducing cost while keeping latency).

Commercial / GTM signals:
- Budget: early-stage runway; willing to commit to small monthly starter plan if latency SLOs are demonstrably met. Estimated ARR band $5k-$25k.
- Customer cites cost sensitivity; will consider Dedicated only if scale/latency needs justify. For now, Hosted API preferred.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We want it to feel instantaneous in the app — anything that looks like a pause loses trust." — Elena
- "If we can get consistent <200ms p95 and smooth streaming we can convert beta customers quickly." — Jason

Next steps (short):
- SE deep-dive scheduled (Arjun) to review architecture, share tuning guide and recommended model variants. (Action: increase trial quota for soak)
- Provide short benchmark runbook (how to reproduce p95 measurements) and a streaming cost estimate for expected Q3 scale.
- Customer to share anonymized sample prompt set and a 1-week usage window for measurement.

Open questions / blockers:
- Final SAML integration timeline (they want admin SSO before pilot expands).
- Need clarified unit pricing for streaming/token-by-token vs non-streaming payloads.
- Proof that cold-starts can be mitigated with caching/warm pools at hosted tier.
